description: This file defines a mock class ServiceMock for the Service interface, utilizing Google Mock for unit testing. It provides mock implementations for various methods related to service properties and control functions, facilitating testing of components dependent on these interfaces.

classes.name: ServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the Service interface, used for unit testing functionalities dependent on service behaviors.
